name: @w6w-apps/meistertask
description: Manage MeisterTask projects, sections, tasks, checklists, labels and comments via the MeisterTask REST API.

w6w.longDescription:
MeisterTask is a Kanban-style project and task manager from the Meister suite (alongside MindMeister). This app covers the everyday project-management path: creating and organising projects, moving work between the sections that make up a project board, and creating, updating and reading the tasks and subtasks that live on it.

A task's supporting detail is covered too — checklists and checklist items for breaking work down further, labels for categorising tasks project-wide, and comments for discussion on a task — plus read access to the people who make up a team, so a workflow can look up who to assign work to.

Authentication follows the vendor's own two paths: a personal access token for a single account's own automations, or a full OAuth 2.0 flow (delegated through MindMeister's authorization server, which MeisterTask shares) for a public integration serving many end users.
